# Waqas Aziz | Logo and Brand Identity Designer

Strategic logo design and brand identity for startups and growing businesses. Logos with purpose, identities that last. Based in Lahore, Pakistan, working worldwide.

## Who is Waqas Aziz

Waqas Aziz is a logo and brand identity designer. Designer first, strategist always. He works with startups and growing businesses, building identities that communicate clearly, stay consistent, and last. Beyond client work, he builds practical digital products for other designers: presentation kits, brand guideline templates, and client kits taken from his own workflow. Each one is made to save you time and help you present like a studio.

## Services

### Logo Design

A logo is the face of your business. This service gives you a mark that is simple, distinctive, and flexible enough to work everywhere, from a favicon to a storefront.

### Complete Brand Identity

A logo alone does not make a brand. This service builds the full visual system around your mark, so every touchpoint looks and feels like one company.

### Brand Guidelines

If you already have a logo, this service turns it into a rulebook. Clear documentation protects your brand from inconsistent use across designers, printers, and platforms.

### Brand Applications

Your identity, applied. This service takes your brand and rolls it out across the materials you actually need: packaging, social templates, marketing pieces, and decks.

## Process: how it works

A simple, transparent process from first message to final files.

1. Brief. You describe your business, audience, and goals in a short project brief.
2. Concepts. Directions are explored and the strongest logo concepts are presented with reasoning.
3. Refinement. The chosen direction is refined together through the agreed revision rounds.
4. Delivery. You receive the complete file package with usage notes. Full ownership transfers on final payment.

## Frequently asked questions

### What services do you offer?

Four services: Logo Design, Complete Brand Identity, Brand Guidelines, and Brand Applications. Each is scoped individually around your business goals.

### How do we start a project?

Fill in the Start a Project form with your brief. Expect a reply within 2 business days with questions and a tailored quote. Once scope and timeline are agreed, design begins.

### How much does a logo or brand identity cost?

Every project is quoted individually after a short brief. There are no fixed prices. The quote depends on scope, deliverables, and timeline.

### How long does a project take?

It depends on the scope. Timelines are confirmed in your quote after the brief, so you know exactly what to expect before work starts. A logo alone moves faster than a full identity system.

### What files will I receive?

Vector sources (AI, EPS, SVG) plus high resolution PNG and JPG exports. Identity projects also include a guidelines document covering logo usage, colors, and typography.

### Do you offer revisions?

Yes. Every project includes structured revision rounds, defined in your quote before work begins.

### Who owns the final logo?

Full ownership of the final logo transfers to you on final payment, as stated in the Terms of Service.

### Do you work with clients outside Pakistan?

Yes. Based in Lahore, working with clients worldwide through an async process with regular check ins, so time zones are never a problem.

### How do I receive a digital product?

Checkout and delivery run on Gumroad. You get download links in your receipt email immediately after payment, and the files stay in your Gumroad library.

### Can I get a refund on a digital product?

If the files are defective or not as described, contact within 7 days of purchase. Each case is reviewed individually. See the Refund Policy for details.
